import pandas as pd
import openpyxl
from pathlib import Path

# Load the spreadsheet
spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/418-29/1_418-29_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/418-29_3_bfd92c1b/1_418-29_output.xlsx"

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Load the workbook
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)

# Load the 'Extracted Data' sheet
df = pd.read_excel(spreadsheet_path, sheet_name='Extracted Data', header=None)

# Rename columns for clarity
df.columns = ['Reference', 'Value']

# Process the data according to the instruction
# For each reference number, calculate the net value (first - sum of rest)
result_rows = []
processed_refs = set()

for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    ref = row['Reference']
    
    if ref not in processed_refs:
        # Find all rows with this reference
        matching_rows = df[df['Reference'] == ref]
        
        if len(matching_rows) > 1:
            # Get all values for this reference
            values = matching_rows['Value'].tolist()
            # Net value = first value - sum of subsequent values
            # Or equivalently: sum of first minus sum of rest
            # Actually, based on the example: 549.75 - 549.35 = 0.40
            # So it's: first occurrence value - second occurrence value (and so on)
            net_value = values[0]
            for i in range(1, len(values)):
                net_value -= values[i]
        else:
            # Only one occurrence, keep the original value
            net_value = row['Value']
        
        result_rows.append({'Reference': ref, 'Value': net_value})
        processed_refs.add(ref)

# Create result dataframe

    ws[f'B{row}'].value = None

# Write the processed data
for idx, row in result_df.iterrows():
    ws[f'A{idx+1}'].value = row['Reference']
    ws[f'B{idx+1}'].value = row['Value']

# Save the workbook
wb.save(output_path)

print("Processing complete!")
print("\nResult:")
print(result_df)
